pages.text: $(l)Branded Progress$() only goes up while you are Branded and actively playing: moving, fighting, mining. Going AFK doesn't count.$(br2)The sin weapons, Apex remnants, and Brandkeeper's Mercy need $(l)99.5%$() of the track by default. A config option can skip this in creative mode.

pages.title: Branded Time Checker
pages.text: Made from a $(item)Book$() and a $(item)Gold Ring$(). Use it to check your Branded Progress and whether you've hit the 99.5% gate.
